tools.description: The migration check: analyse a Google Image Charts / Image-Charts / QuickChart URL and report, parameter by parameter, what UrlChart will render, degrade, ignore or not support — plus the equivalent UrlChart URL. tools.name: build_chart_url
tools.description: Build a well-formed UrlChart chart URL from a small, LLM-friendly chart spec. No render, no network, no key. Returns the URL as text; pass it to generate_chart_image (or embed it) to get the PNG. For chart types or parameters outside this spec, use generate_chart_image with raw legacy parameters.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_chart_image" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
